messages:
Theo R.: quick sync: we've had three customer reports about cost mis-attribution after the last rollout. i'd like to reconcile the attribution key story end-to-end. high level thoughts?
Kavita P.: sounds good. root cause from what i saw: different services use different keys (user_id vs acct_id vs external_id) and our join in the billing pipeline prefers the first non-null. that made counts inconsistent per-tenant.
Omar N.: yep. also some regions surface `account_id` as numeric string vs padded GUID in eu region which broke the hash that drives our cost shards.
Bea L.: ops note: the reconciliation job we ran filled in some missing keys but created duplicate billing rows because aliases weren't canonicalized. we need a canonicalization map and alias resolution step.
Theo R.: proposal: define three canonical concepts: billing_key (stable per-billing-entity), attribution_key (used in telemetry joins), and display_id (for product UX). map all incoming keys to billing_key at ingest where possible, and attach provenance metadata.
Kavita P.: agree. map should be small and owned by product-metrics. we need versioned mappings so backfills can re-run deterministically. store mapping as key->canonical with a JSON blob like: "{ \"v\":2, \"map\":\"acct_guid->billing:acct:...\" }" but keep it compact.
Omar N.: can we do canonicalization at the router with a signed mapping cache? router does best-effort mapping, emits both original and canonical in the envelope. downstream billing uses canonical if present, else falls back to legacy resolution.
Bea L.: yes but watch perf. router lookups must be O(1) and local. recommend a small LRU cache with periodic snapshots from mapping service. if cache miss, tag event as unmapped and route to quarantine for async resolution.
telemetry-bot: ALERT: last reconciliation run created ~0.8% duplicate billing rows. Recommend a dedupe pass and stricter mapping tests. :warning:
Theo R.: good point. we should add an idempotency key to billing rows derived from (tenant, canonical_billing_key, ingestion_bucket, dedup_window). then backfill can be run without creating duplicates.
Kavita P.: also need a reconciliation job contract: publish job input snapshot path, mapping version, and expected error budget. include a dry-run mode that writes a validation report with expected delta per-tenant.
Omar N.: for cross-region differences (formatting, currency), we should normalize at ingest: canonical_billing_key + region_tag + currency_code. cost conversion must happen in billing pipeline, not in telemetry ingestion.
Bea L.: add monitoring: metric rdwd.attr.unmapped.count, rdwd.attr.duplicates.count, and rdwd.attr.canonical_version{ver=...}. Add an alert when unmapped rate > 0.1% of QPS for 10m.
Theo R.: migration strategy: 1) introduce canonical fields in envelope (canonical_billing_key, billing_key_ver, attr_provenance), 2) run reconciliation dry-runs for 2 weeks, 3) flip billing consumers to prefer canonical, 4) run backfill with idempotency and mapping version pin.
Kavita P.: also include an audit trail API so customers can query how their events were mapped for a given time-range and mapping version. important for billing disputes.
Omar N.: implement small SDK helper to call mapping service and optionally set `X-Rdwd-Attr: id=xyz;ver=2;sig=...` for migration flows. internal migration jobs get signature permission. public traffic uses tenant config default.
Bea L.: ops: quarantine queue should keep originals for 7 days and provide a manual resolution UI for mappings. backfill request must include cost estimate and idempotency token. billing signs off.
telemetry-bot: NOTE: created issue #2048 for mapping-versioning and #2049 for idempotency-dedupe.
Theo R.: action items: Kavita to own mapping contract + audit API, Omar to prototype router cache + SDK header, Bea to extend quarantine UI and dedupe, i'll draft the migration runbook. target: RFC + dry-run infra in 2 weeks.
Kavita P.: i'll also include SQL snippets showing old-vs-new joins and an example dry-run report template.
Omar N.: will add perf test for router cache latency and fallback path.
Bea L.: i'll add alerts and a sampling dashboard for manual inspection.
Theo R.: thanks all. once RFC is in i'll schedule a 30m review with billing & product-metrics. :thumbsup:
